digest.component_or_area: contributor docs for post-merge close discipline (AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md)
propositions: A subagent fast-forwarded the shared main checkout to satisfy a ticket close, clobbering uncommitted operator WIP.
The close completion precheck requires the merged rebar-ticket commit to be reachable from HEAD in the closing checkout, so authors must fast-forward their own worktree after a Gerrit merge.
Contributor guidance never instructed authors to fast-forward only their own worktree and never touch the shared main checkout.
The fix is documentation-only, editing AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md with no src/rebar code changes.
AGENTS.md gains a post-merge fast-forward-your-worktree bullet plus a never-touch-the-shared-main-checkout warning.
CONTRIBUTING.md gains a new §2f subsection carrying the same post-merge close guidance after §2e Submit.
